Metadata.title: GitHub Project Hub
Metadata.description: GitHub 开源项目数据聚合与展示平台，支持 MCP / Skill 协作同步

Landing.title: Periodically fetch and store repository data
Landing.subtitle: Admins add repositories manually, or third-party apps submit them via API with an optional callback URL — the system automatically fetches stars, contributors, package data and snapshots on a daily / weekly / monthly basis, then calls back the webhook when processing completes.
Landing.featureDescA: Runs daily via Vercel Cron to automatically fetch repository stars, contributors, README, package data and snapshot records, persisted into the database.
Landing.featureDescB: Third-party apps submit repositories via POST /api/projects/create; when a webhookUrl is provided, the callback fires automatically when processing completes.
Landing.featureDescC: A single console to review projects, scheduled task status and failed syncs, with retry and manual execution support.
Landing.howStep1Desc: Manually in the console, or pushed by third-party apps through the API.
Landing.howStep2Desc: Daily / weekly / monthly schedulers automatically fetch and store GitHub data and snapshots.
Landing.howStep3Desc: Once data is persisted, results are asynchronously posted back to the configured webhook URL.
Landing.ctaBottomTitle: Ready to build your project data hub?
Landing.ctaBottomDesc: Sign in to add repositories, manage scheduled tasks and integrate your product via the API.

ApiDocs.title: API integration
ApiDocs.subtitle: Third-party apps submit repositories via API; the platform calls back your webhook once data is stored.
ApiDocs.sectionSubmitDesc: Push a GitHub repository URL to the platform; the system fetches repository data and stores it automatically.
ApiDocs.authDesc: This API requires a signed-in session (carried automatically by the current browser session); the webhookUrl callback field is optional.
ApiDocs.callbackDesc: When a webhookUrl is provided, the system POSTs the full project data to that URL once processing completes.

callbackItems.0: Basic project info (ID, name, description, slug, etc.)
callbackItems.1: GitHub data (stars, contributor count, topics, etc.)
callbackItems.2: Package data (version, downloads, dependencies, if available)

noteItems.0: If the repository already exists, the existing project data is returned and nothing is created twice.
noteItems.1: Data processing runs asynchronously in the background; use webhookUrl to receive a completion notification.
noteItems.2: type supports skill | application | client | server; it defaults to application.

ApiDocs.managedDesc: Admins can also add or edit projects manually in the console; both go through the same scheduled fetching pipeline.
